text:
Maria: Trying to bring up Llama-2-13B-v2 quantized with AWQ->INT8 pipeline on the TRT-LLM stack, H100s, CUDA 14 + driver 545.35 and it's segfaulting in a TensorRT kernel. Repro is small.

Maria: log snippet:
```
E TensorRT-LLM: engine build failed: kernel.cu:142 memcpy: invalid device pointer
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Aborted (core dumped)
```

Jon: what command / docker image? can you paste the exact run line?

Maria: `docker run --gpus all -e CUDA_VERSION=14 --env TRT_BACKEND=trtllm redwood/trtllm:gpu-2026-03 ./serve --model llama-2-13b-v2 --quant awq --dtype int8 --max-seq 2048`

Kevin: suspecting a driver/kernel mismatch with our TRT-LLM build. We've seen similar on H100 w/ 545.x where a memcpy from pinned host memory goes to a different device context and crashes. Two quick checks:
- try `--max-seq 1024` (to avoid odd kernel tiling)
- run with `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1` removed or set `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` to force single GPU

Eva: I ran a quick micro-bake on A100 (CUDA12 + driver 525) w/ same AWQ+INT8 artifacts. Build succeeded but accuracy dropped a bit vs fp16. MMLU quick: fp16 baseline 63.2, awq-int8 61.4 (-1.8). Winogrande small set: fp16 78.0 -> awq-int8 76.7 (-1.3). Not catastrophic but measurable.

Tim: two follow-ups: (1) that accuracy delta matches what we saw in the AWQ paper when using scale-only rounding; (2) for the segfault, try forcing engine fallback to fp16 in TRT-LLM: add `--force-fp16-engine` or set `TRTLLM_ALLOW_FP_FALLBACK=1` in env (we surfaced a flag for builds after 2026-02)

Maria: tried `--force-fp16-engine` — the serve starts and stays up. Perf is slightly worse but stable. So it's definitely a quant-kernel codepath problem on CUDA14/545.

Jon: can you capture `dmesg` and full `nvidia-smi -q`? Also run `trtexec --loadEngine` on a tiny engine to see if TensorRT itself complains.

Maria: pasted `nvidia-smi` output and attached a minimal repro engine in the bug report I just filed. dmesg shows `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31` around the abort.

Kevin: filing with Nvidia + adding repro to our infra ticket. Short-term mitigation for customers: pin to CUDA12/driver 525 for TRT-LLM AWQ int8 workloads or run under vLLM fallback (vLLM seems to avoid the tensorrt kernel path and stays in cuBLAS/cuDNN).

Eva: added the accuracy deltas to the bakeoff tracking sheet (link: https://redwood/sheets/quant-bakeoff). Marked this config as "unstable" in the deployment profiles table.

ci-bot: created ticket INF-4592 and attached logs from `1774822330` thread.

Tim: note for release notes: if customers use AWQ+INT8 on H100 with CUDA14, recommend `--force-fp16-engine` or use our Dedicated nodes with validated CUDA+driver image.

Maria: thanks all — I'll keep the thread updated with Nvidia response and the triage steps. Next: run full eval suite (MMLU/GSM8K/HF-RAE) under fp16 and awq-int8 on A100 vs H100 and paste numbers here.

Jon: +1, and please add the minimal repro command to the docs under `eng-ml/quant-bakeoffs` so infra can reproduce.

Maria: will do. :thumbsup:
